identity.title: The Circular Economy Project at NIST

content.description: The goal of the Circular Economy program is to coordinate NIST resources to support the Nation’s need to transition away from a linear – take, make, use, waste – economic model toward one in which materials repeatedly cycle within the economy. For NIST, this involves inter-agency collaboration, identification of external stakeholder needs and innovations in measurements and standards that enable decreased dependence of economic activity on the consumption of virgin resources. Among the activities supported by this program is the creation of the CE Resource Registry for collecting data and information resource useful for understanding that current state of the Circular Economy.
